treatment_start_source: README_region_subsidy.md: 'received an investment subsidy from quarter 13'
design: two-way fixed effects DiD, region and quarter FE, all rows, no covariates, uniform treatment timing (single start quarter)

roles_justification.unit: region_id takes values 1-30 and is constant across quarters; README calls it the region identifier
roles_justification.time: quarter takes values 1-24 with no gaps; README calls it the period
roles_justification.outcome: investment, million euro, float, never empty; README question is about private investment
roles_justification.treatment: subsidy_region is the only treatment-related column; it is boolean, constant within region, and splits 10 treated from 20 control regions
roles_justification.timing: no treatment-date column exists in the data; the start quarter comes from the README text, which fixes a single start quarter for all treated regions
